statements.sql: CREATE TABLE items(id integer PRIMARY KEY, v TEXT NOT NULL)

WITH RECURSIVE ancestry(commit_hash) AS (
  SELECT dolt_hashof('feature')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT parents.parent_hash
  FROM ancestry
  JOIN dolt_commit_ancestors parents
    ON parents.commit_hash = ancestry.commit_hash
   AND parents.parent_index = 0
  WHERE parents.parent_hash IS NOT NULL
) SELECT CONCAT('H|', count(*)) FROM ancestry JOIN dolt_history_items history ON history.commit_hash = ancestry.commit_hash
